about: Seoul list house look (fixed: one house look per style, small variation per reel). Only the content of each line changes per reel.

type.fact: Inter Tight 800 (CAPS for the contrast word)
type.on_footage: white, tight dark halo + soft shadow
type.on_light_clothing: Inter Tight 800 (the serif is too thin there)

pages.flash: white page, black heavy connector word

vary_per_reel: the footage (the user's own first when they hand it over; stock or AI may be full screen)
tolerance_note: measured on footage frames (beach vs city differ by content): saturation and contrast bands are wider than for face-measured styles
footage_rule: a format, not a footage source: the user's own footage first when provided, then own_footage.py, then stock/AI full screen; one graded world, no posed stock models, reference pace, 1080p+
grade_rule: reference data only, never applied to the speaker's face: the footage stays as shot and the inserts are conformed to it; broll_qa.py as_shot fails a regraded plate
components_rule: the house look is the type, captions, accents, insert framing and the speaker's face as shot; phone-UI scenes, paper props, polaroid / card / collage treatments, transitions, hook and outro devices are NEW every reel (scripts/components.py plan / check / record, catalog.json)

example_components.outro: iMessage bubble with the closing word + tapback; 1-4 frames from the reel float off
example_components.hook: shrinking card + red glitch word + 1-3 Fluent stickers
